Welcome.title: Publishub tells you what to change in your video, second by second.
Welcome.lead: It doesn't edit for you. It watches the video, finds what costs you viewers, and hands you an ordered plan: what to cut, change, add and improve, each item with the second it belongs to.

1.title: Send a Reel
1.text: Just the video file, exactly as you published it. Up to 50 MB. The retention screenshot from Insights is optional.

2.title: Wait about 3 minutes
2.text: Publishub transcribes the speech, watches the frames and writes the action plan. You can leave the page: it keeps running.

3.title: Edit with the plan beside you
3.text: Each item has a timestamp that jumps the player there. Tick them off as you go, in the editor you already use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what data Publishub collects, why, and what you can do about it. Written to be read, not to hide behind jargon.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: From your account: your email and, if you want, a name. From your use: the videos and screenshots you send, the transcript and analysis we generate from them, and usage events (which screen opened, whether the analysis finished, whether a payment went through) with none of what you say in the video. From payment: Stripe processes the card; we keep only the record that the purchase happened, the amount and the email used.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: To generate your analysis, keep your history, charge you when you buy, send the 72-hour reminder if you ask for it, and understand where the product fails. We don't sell any data and we don't use your video to train models of our own.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Supabase (database, login and file storage), Google Gemini (processes the audio and frames to generate the analysis), Stripe (payment), Resend (the reminder email) and, only if you connect it, Manus (receives the action plan as text, never the video). Each one gets only what its part needs.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: As long as your account exists. Deleting your account removes the videos, screenshots, analyses and the login; the tax record of a purchase stays for the period the law requires, unlinked from your identity.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can see, correct and delete your data. Deletion lives on your account page and is immediate. If you'd rather, write to support and we'll do it for you.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use the Supabase session cookie (to keep you signed in) and a language cookie (to remember whether you chose EN, PT or ES). No third-party trackers, no social pixels.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Files sit in private storage, reachable only by your account or our server, through short-lived links. Integration keys you connect (such as the Manus one) are encrypted before being stored.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Privacy questions, deletion or a copy of your data: write to support at the address in the footer of this page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The rules for using Publishub. Creating an account means you agree to them.

sections.title: What Publishub does
sections.body: Publishub analyzes short videos and returns recommendations: the second your audience drops, the line you were saying at it, and an action plan of what to cut, change, add and improve. It does not edit your video and does not guarantee audience, reach or results: the recommendations are analysis, not a promise.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping access to your account safe. Use Publishub if you are 18 or older, or with permission from whoever is responsible for you.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: Your videos stay yours. You give us permission to process them for the single purpose of generating your analysis and showing you the result. Don't send illegal content, or material from others that you have no right to.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Don't try to get around usage limits, automate sign-ups or overload the service. Accounts doing that can be suspended.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment, processed by Stripe, that unlocks full analyses and the action plan. "Lifetime" means as long as Publishub exists as a service. If something goes wrong with your purchase, write to support: we refund within the legal cooling-off period.

sections.title: Availability and changes
sections.body: The service can have downtime, and features can change. Changes that take something meaningful away from people who already paid will be announced by email.

sections.title: Limit of liability
sections.body: Publishub is provided as is. We're not responsible for editorial decisions you make from the recommendations, nor for reach results on the platforms where you publish.

sections.title: Ending and governing law
sections.body: You can delete your account whenever you want, from the account page. These terms follow Brazilian law.

support.title: Talk to a person
support.lead: Questions, a payment problem, a refund or a deletion request: write to us. A human answers, usually within one business day.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.lead: This removes your videos, screenshots, analyses and your login. It's immediate and can't be undone. The tax record of purchases stays for the period the law requires, unlinked from you.
delete.confirmLabel: To confirm, type your account email
